title: Ijwi ry'imbere y'igihuhusi
intro: Igishushanyo co mu bugaragwa carahagurutse kugira ngo kihamagare ihanga rikomeye ngo risubire mu kuri. Abantu bari bazwi kubera inyubakwa zabo nziza cane be n’inkomezi zabo zitagira uko zingana. Yamara ubwibone bwabo bwarahuma amaso, banka kwumva. Amaherezo, igihano gikomeye cane carabashikiye, kigakiza umugwi mutoyi gusa w’abizera.
clues: Narungitswe ku bantu b’abanyabubasha baba mu bihugu vyagutse kandi bazwi kubera ububasha bwabo.
Abantu banje baje bakurikiye irindi hanga rikomeye ryari ryarambuwe.
Bari bafise ibibanza vyiza cane kandi bubaka iminara miremire.
Nabahamagariye gusenga Imana Imwe, ariko banse guheba ibigirwamana vyabo.
Igihano c’ubukazi carabashikiye, kizigama abo bemeranye nanje gusa.
Ndi uwarungitswe ku bantu b’inkomezi bazwi kw’izina rya Aad.

options: Abantu banje barimbuwe n’umuyaga w’inkazi, nanje nkizwa .
Abantu banje baratera amabuye bavuye mw’ijuru .

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
